sonnet.problem: The question asks "Why not?" and treats "His heart trusts in the LORD" as the reason he does not fear bad news. Psalm 112:7 sets the two clauses side by side ("He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD") and gives no connector such as "for" or "because". The card therefore adds a reason the text does not state. Unlike the Psalm 23 example, which rests on an explicit "for", nothing here marks it as the reason.
sonnet.rule: Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
